result.instructions: Tools for ipapi.is, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Is 45.33.32.156 a VPN, proxy, Tor exit or datacenter address?"; "Who owns the IP 8.8.8.8 and where is the abuse contact?"; "Check these 20 IPs from my login logs and list the risky ones.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ipapi.is data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ipapi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ipapi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ipapi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ipapi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ipapi_lookup_ip
tools.description: Look up one IPv4 or IPv6 address in ipapi.is: owner company, network, abuse contact, location, and the flags is_datacenter, is_vpn, is_proxy, is_tor, is_abuser, is_mobile, is_crawler. Spends 1 request of your ipapi.is quota.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address, for example 8.8.8.8.

all_companies.description: Return every WHOIS record that covers the address (company becomes an array).

geolocation_sources.description: Add location.geofeed: the geofeed URLs used to locate the address.

tools.name: ipapi_lookup_asn
tools.description: Look up one autonomous system (AS number) in ipapi.is: organization, registry, type, country and announced routes. Spends 1 request of your ipapi.is quota.

asn.description: AS number, with or without the AS prefix, for example AS15169 or 15169.

tools.name: ipapi_bulk_lookup
tools.description: Look up up to 100 IP addresses and AS numbers in one ipapi.is request. The result is an object keyed by the entries you sent. Every entry spends 1 request of your ipapi.is quota. Duplicates and invalid entries are dropped silently by ipapi.is.

entries.description: IP addresses and AS numbers (AS15169), 1 to 100 entries.

annotations.title: Look up many IPs or AS numbers
